prompt: A dramatic close-up studio portrait of a character, rendered in a 3/4 profile view facing towards the left. The scene features high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting, with a brilliant, crisp key light illuminating the contours of the forehead, nose, and chin from the top-left, casting the back of the head and shoulders into deep shadow. The color palette is earthy and atmospheric, dominated by deep mahogany, charcoal gray, and near-black shadows, accented by warm sandy-beige and pale cream highlights. The background is a flat, neutral slate-gray studio backdrop.
